items.description:

Sunshine intervals and a few isolated blustery showers.


##Temperature##

##Rainfall (mm):##

0-2

NW


##Wind##

W soon veering W-NW, 25-35 with gusts 35-45, veering NW 20-25 by the evening, backing W-NW or W 10-15 overnight into Sunday.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly falling moderate in any showers.
